instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. Inside a martial arts gym with grey padded walls, the shirtless man with a mullet (R2) on the left and the man in the black t-shirt (R1) on the right continue sparring. The shirtless man (R2) throws a straight left punch, while the man in the black t-shirt (R1) ducks low to slip the punch and lunges forward. Both wear glasses, boxing gloves, and white shin guards. In the background, a bystander in a black t-shirt stands watching. Neutral overhead lighting illuminates the grey floor mats.
